skill.name: meituan-coupon
skill.description: Meituan coupon assistant for claiming available coupons, guiding SMS account login, checking redemption history, and managing daily coupon reminder settings.
skill.summary: Claim Meituan coupons, verify account access, and review redemption history.
skill.author: Meituan-Open-Platform

security_audit.summary: The audit confirms real risk from bundled Python script execution, local persistence of user tokens and device identifiers, outbound Meituan API calls, and recurring coupon automation. Many static hits are false positives from Markdown backticks, comments, Chinese prose entropy, and dictionary key terminology, but the remaining confirmed findings are security-relevant. This skill should not be auto-installed without explicit user review and publisher verification.

remediation.issue: Prompt-like priority rules and forced script execution in skill instructions
remediation.suggestion: Remove priority override language, avoid instructions that hide execution details, and require explicit user consent before running scripts.

remediation.issue: Phone, SMS code, user_token, and device_token handling
remediation.suggestion: Minimize token lifetime, encrypt local token storage where possible, document exact retention, and provide a reliable one-command purge.

remediation.issue: Recurring coupon claiming can run without per-run confirmation
remediation.suggestion: Require an explicit opt-in confirmation, show the scheduler target and time, and provide clear disable and audit status commands.
Constrain executable paths to bundled or trusted locations, validate environment overrides, and fail closed on unexpected paths.

remediation.issue: Official-branding claims in a community-source report
remediation.suggestion: Verify publisher ownership and official authorization before publishing marketplace copy that asks users for account credentials.

semantic_findings.title: Official Branding Used During Credential Request

semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The official-brand claim and credential request are present in the cited text. The risk is publisher-trust context rather than proof that the claim is false.

content.user_title: Claim Meituan Coupons and Track Redemptions
content.value_statement: Users need a guided way to claim Meituan coupons and review past redemptions. This skill runs the coupon, login, history, and reminder flows through bundled scripts.
actual_capabilities: Checks whether the user accepted the service terms before coupon actions.
Guides SMS login for a Meituan account and stores account tokens locally.
Calls Meituan coupon issue endpoints with a channel code and user token.
Formats successful coupon results with name, amount, validity dates, and use links.
Queries local redemption codes and requests matching coupon records from Meituan.
Stores and reports daily automatic coupon preference and scheduler identifiers.
limitations: Requires a valid Meituan account, phone number, and SMS verification code.
Coupon availability, amount, and eligibility depend on Meituan service responses.
Uses bundled Python scripts, local files, and outbound network requests.
Automatic daily claiming depends on scheduler support in the active agent platform.

use_cases.title: Daily coupon claiming
use_cases.description: Claim available Meituan coupons for a user after login and show the coupon details.

use_cases.title: Redemption record lookup
use_cases.description: Review coupon records for a selected date or date range using saved redemption codes.

use_cases.title: Coupon reminder setup
use_cases.description: Save a preferred daily coupon time and return platform-specific scheduling details.

prompt_templates.title: Claim today coupons
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a normal coupon claim.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me claim any available Meituan coupons for today.

prompt_templates.title: Check login status
prompt_templates.scenario: User wants to know whether authentication is ready.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether my Meituan coupon login is valid before claiming coupons.

prompt_templates.title: Review a date range
prompt_templates.prompt: Show my Meituan coupon redemption records from March 20 to March 23.

prompt_templates.title: Set daily claiming
prompt_templates.prompt: Set up daily Meituan coupon claiming at 10:00 Beijing time and tell me the result.

output_examples.output: The skill confirms login status, requests any missing verification, then reports the coupon names, amounts, validity dates, and use links.

output_examples.input: What coupons did I claim yesterday?
output_examples.output: The skill asks for or parses the date, checks saved redemption records, and summarizes matching coupon records or says no records were found.

output_examples.input: Remind me to claim coupons every morning.
output_examples.output: The skill saves the preferred time, identifies the supported scheduling platform, and returns whether the recurring task was created.

best_practices: Use the skill only after confirming the user wants to log in or claim coupons.
Keep phone numbers, SMS codes, user tokens, and device tokens out of chat output.
Review local storage and scheduler settings before enabling automatic daily claiming.
anti_patterns: Do not run login or coupon scripts for unrelated shopping or food questions.
Do not paste full tokens, phone numbers, or SMS codes into visible responses.
Do not enable recurring coupon claiming without explicit user consent.

faq.question: Does this skill require a Meituan account?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires a registered Meituan account and SMS verification before claiming coupons.

faq.question: Where are tokens stored?
faq.answer: The bundled scripts store tokens in local cache files under the user workspace.

faq.question: Does it contact external services?
faq.answer: Yes. It sends requests to Meituan service endpoints to verify login, issue coupons, and query records.

faq.question: Can it guarantee coupon availability?
faq.answer: No. Coupon results depend on account eligibility, campaign status, quota, and Meituan responses.

faq.question: Can it claim coupons automatically every day?
faq.answer: It can save a daily claiming preference and return scheduler instructions when the platform supports them.

faq.question: Is this safe to install without review?
faq.answer: No. It runs scripts, stores authentication data, sends network requests, and can configure recurring actions.
